tldr: 台股週二（8/11）上漲191.96點收45,120.72點、重返4萬5關卡，台積電漲15元至2,395元撐盤，投資人選股不追高，等待美國通膨數據。
台積電上修2026美元營收成長至「略高於40%」，AI相關營收估破兆元、訂單能見度直達2028年。
金管會對合庫信用卡缺失開罰，並鬆綁金控共同行銷與子公司減資規範。
8月高股息ETF除息潮登場，00878配息1.01元創新高，8月18日除息。
美股8/11收黑靜待通膨數據，油價連四漲、金價站穩4,400美元，反映荷莫茲海峽地緣風險。

items.title_zh: 台股收漲191點重回4萬5 台積電撐盤
items.title_en: Taiex adds 192 points to reclaim 45,000 as TSMC holds gains
items.summary_zh: 加權指數週二（8/11）上漲191.96點、收45,120.72點，漲幅0.43%，成交值8,690億元，重返45,000點大關。台積電上漲15元至2,395元撐住盤面，惟追價買盤轉趨謹慎，多方在美國本週通膨數據公布前維持震盪整理，本波反彈格局尚未受到破壞。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index rose 191.96 points on Tuesday (Aug 11) to close at 45,120.72, up 0.43%, on turnover of NT$869bn, reclaiming the 45,000 mark. TSMC gained NT$15 to NT$2,395 and anchored the index even as traders turned cautious about chasing highs, keeping the current rebound intact ahead of key US inflation data due later this week.

items.title_zh: AI、PCB族群獲買盤青睞 台積電盤中再創高
items.title_en: AI and PCB names draw buying as TSMC sets fresh intraday high
items.summary_zh: 台積電週二盤中再度改寫盤中新高，資金輪動流向AI伺服器供應鏈與PCB類股，科技權值續居盤面核心。高速板、先進封裝與散熱相關個股吸引買盤進駐，使參與面由晶圓代工龍頭向外擴散；惟整體成交顯示投資人選股不追高，操作維持相對審慎。
items.summary_en: Buying rotated into AI-server supply names and PCB makers on Tuesday as TSMC briefly set a new intraday high, keeping technology heavyweights at the center of the market. Advanced-packaging, high-speed board and cooling-related plays attracted funds, broadening participation beyond the foundry leader, though overall turnover showed investors staying selective rather than chasing the whole board higher.

items.title_zh: 台積電上修2026美元營收成長至逾4成 AI需求「極強」
items.title_en: TSMC lifts 2026 dollar-revenue guidance toward the mid-40s% as AI demand stays "extremely strong"
items.summary_zh: 台積電將2026年美元營收成長目標由「逾30%」上修至「略高於40%」，形容AI需求極其強勁，主要來自雲端業者及其下游客戶。法人估AI相關營收可望突破400億美元、跨過新台幣兆元大關，訂單能見度已延伸至2028年，先進製程與封裝產能持續滿載，支撐全年成長動能。
items.summary_en: TSMC has guided 2026 US-dollar revenue growth to "slightly above 40%," up from an earlier "over 30%," describing AI demand as extremely strong and led by cloud service providers. Analysts see AI-related revenue topping US$40bn and crossing the NT$1tn mark, with order visibility now extending to 2028 as advanced-node and packaging capacity remains fully booked.

items.title_zh: 記憶體、被動元件搭上AI上升循環
items.title_en: Memory and passive-component makers ride the AI-driven upcycle
items.summary_zh: 記憶體、被動元件與矽晶圓族群延續回溫，AI伺服器與高頻寬記憶體（HBM）需求帶動供給趨緊、價格轉強，漲勢擴散至整體科技供應鏈。此波動能顯示AI資本支出循環正把台灣硬體供應鏈更廣泛族群拉進上升軌道，從DRAM、NAND到板類與電源管理元件皆受惠資料中心建置需求延伸。
items.summary_en: Memory chipmakers, passive-component and silicon-wafer suppliers extended a recovery as AI-server and high-bandwidth-memory demand tightened supply and firmed pricing across the technology chain. The strength signals the AI capital-spending cycle is pulling a broader slice of Taiwan's hardware supply chain into the upturn, from DRAM and NAND names to boards and power-management components feeding data-center buildouts.

items.title_zh: 金管會對合庫信用卡疑義帳款開罰 並公布6月卡務與電支數據
items.title_en: FSC fines Taiwan Cooperative Bank over credit-card disputed-charge lapses; releases June card and e-payment data
items.summary_zh: 金管會8月11日發布對合作金庫商業銀行辦理信用卡疑義帳款作業缺失的行政處分，同時公布115年6月份信用卡、現金卡及電子支付機構業務資訊。此舉凸顯主管機關持續聚焦消費者保護內控與支付產業透明度，因應信用卡與電子支付使用規模持續擴大下的監理要求。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission on Aug 11 published an administrative sanction against Taiwan Cooperative Bank for deficiencies in handling disputed credit-card charges, and released June statistics for credit cards, cash cards and electronic-payment institutions. The actions underscore the regulator's continued focus on consumer-protection controls and payment-sector transparency as card and e-payment usage keeps expanding.

items.title_zh: 金管會鬆綁金控共同行銷與子公司減資規範
items.title_en: FSC eases holding-company rules on cross-marketing and subsidiary capital reduction
items.summary_zh: 金管會8月7日修正金融機構合作推廣他業商品或提供相關服務規範，並修正「金融控股公司之子公司間共同行銷管理辦法」及「金融控股公司之子公司減資辦法」相關條文。此番調整旨在給予金融集團更多營運彈性，同時維持銀行、保險與證券子公司在行為規範與資本面的防護機制，兼顧監理與市場競爭。
items.summary_en: The regulator on Aug 7 amended rules governing joint promotion and cross-sale of other firms' products by financial institutions, and revised provisions on cross-marketing among financial-holding subsidiaries and on subsidiary capital-reduction procedures. The changes aim to give financial groups more operating flexibility while maintaining conduct and capital safeguards across bank, insurance and securities arms.

items.title_zh: 8月高股息ETF除息潮 00878配息1.01元創掛牌新高
items.title_en: August high-yield ETF ex-dividend wave: 00878 declares record NT$1.01 payout
items.summary_zh: 國泰永續高股息（00878）本期每受益權單位配息1.01元、創掛牌以來新高，除息日訂於8月18日，最晚須於8月17日前買進方可參與。8月共32檔台股ETF（30檔股票型加2檔債券型）接力除息，集中在4日至25日，替偏好現金流的投資人排出密集的領息行事曆，惟仍須留意填息表現。
items.summary_en: Cathay Sustainability High Dividend ETF (00878) set a record distribution of NT$1.01 per unit this period, with its ex-dividend date on Aug 18 and the last buy-in day Aug 17. It headlines a busy August in which 32 Taiwan ETFs (30 equity plus 2 bond funds) go ex-dividend, clustered between the 4th and 25th, giving income-focused investors a dense calendar to navigate.

items.title_zh: 高殖利率誘人但填息才是關鍵 00881、00923、00961同列8月配息
items.title_en: High yields tempt but filling the gap matters: 00881, 00923, 00961 among August payers
items.summary_zh: 除00878外，本月多檔ETF端出亮眼年化殖利率，包括國泰台灣科技龍頭（00881）預估配息4.6元、群益台ESG低碳50（00923）年化殖利率近15%、FT臺灣永續高息（00961）約17.5%。理財專家提醒，高配息不等於高報酬，除息後的填息速度與長期績效才是決定實質收益的關鍵，投資人應避免只看配息率。
items.summary_en: Beyond 00878, several ETFs flagged eye-catching annualized yields this month, including Cathay Taiwan Tech Leaders (00881) at an estimated NT$4.6 payout, Capital Taiwan ESG Low-Carbon 50 (00923) near a 15% yield, and FT Taiwan Sustainable High Dividend (00961) around 17.5%. Advisers caution that headline yield is not total return—post-ex-dividend price recovery and long-term performance still drive outcomes.

items.title_zh: 2026遺產與贈與稅額度：贈與稅免稅額維持244萬元
items.title_en: Taiwan's 2026 estate- and gift-tax allowances: gift-tax exemption stays at NT$2.44m
items.summary_zh: 2026年贈與稅每年免稅額維持244萬元不變；遺產稅方面，配偶扣除額553萬元、直系血親卑親屬每人扣除56萬元、父母每人扣除138萬元。理財與稅務專家指出，這些額度牽動年底前的贈與與傳承規劃，尤其影響高資產家庭跨世代財產移轉的節奏與架構安排，宜及早試算並善用免稅空間。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's 2026 gift-tax annual exemption remains NT$2.44m, while estate-tax deductions include NT$5.53m for a surviving spouse, NT$560,000 per lineal descendant and NT$1.38m per surviving parent. Advisers note the thresholds shape year-end gifting and succession planning, especially for high-net-worth families structuring transfers across generations.

items.title_zh: 遺贈稅門檻採CPI連動調整機制
items.title_en: Inflation-indexed mechanism governs future estate- and gift-tax thresholds
items.summary_zh: 依遺產及贈與稅法第12-1條，當消費者物價指數累計上漲達10%以上時，免稅額、課稅級距及各項扣除額自次年起按上漲程度調整；財政部應於每年底前計算並公告次年適用金額。此一物價連動機制讓遺贈稅額度隨通膨變化有明確依循，家庭在規劃財產移轉時可據以預估未來免稅空間的變動方向。
items.summary_en: Under Article 12-1 of Taiwan's Estate and Gift Tax Act, exemptions, tax brackets and deductions adjust whenever the cumulative rise in the consumer price index reaches 10% or more, effective the following year. The Ministry of Finance calculates and announces the applicable figures by year-end, giving families a rules-based path for how allowances evolve with inflation.

items.title_zh: 台灣6月CPI年增2.60% 景氣續亮紅燈
items.title_en: Taiwan's June CPI up 2.60% year-on-year; business-cycle signal stays "red"
items.summary_zh: 統計資料顯示，台灣6月消費者物價指數（CPI）較上年同月上漲2.60%、較上月漲0.52%，上半年平均年增1.70%。景氣對策信號續呈代表熱絡的紅燈，領先與同時指標持續上升，顯示國內經濟動能穩健；惟通膨仍在央行關注區間附近徘徊，後續政策維持審慎，市場續留意物價與出口變化。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's June consumer price index rose 2.60% from a year earlier and 0.52% on the month, with the first-half average up 1.70%. The business-cycle monitoring indicator remained a "red" light with leading and coincident indicators still rising, signaling steady domestic momentum even as inflation lingers near the central bank's alert zone.

items.title_zh: 美國關稅不確定性壟罩台灣出口前景
items.title_en: US tariff uncertainty clouds Taiwan's export outlook
items.summary_zh: 分析指出，美國關稅政策細節未明，恐衝擊全球供應鏈與台灣出口動能。若美方對半導體與資通訊（ICT）產品加徵關稅，將推升電子相關產品價格，並衝擊以科技產品為主的台灣出口表現。此變數與2026年仍屬穩健的國內成長預測並存，成為市場關注的下檔風險，企業須留意接單與匯率連動。
items.summary_en: Analysts warn that unresolved US tariff plans could disrupt global supply chains and Taiwan's export momentum. Should Washington levy duties on semiconductors and ICT products, electronics prices would rise and Taiwan's tech-heavy exports could take a hit—an overhang the market watches closely alongside 2026 growth forecasts that remain solid.

items.title_zh: 台媒：8月美國數據密集 Fed動向成焦點
items.title_en: Taiwan media: August's heavy US data calendar keeps the Fed path in focus
items.summary_zh: 台灣券商觀點盤點8月美股「重量級」數據行事曆，涵蓋CPI、非農就業與PCE等8大指標，聚焦聯準會9月究竟「降息或重啟升息」的政策拉鋸。相關報導反映本地投資人高度關注美國通膨數據，因其牽動全球風險胃納，並直接影響以出口與科技為主的台股評價與資金流向。
items.summary_en: Taiwanese brokerage commentary flags a data-packed August for US markets—CPI, nonfarm payrolls and PCE among eight key releases—framing the debate over whether the Federal Reserve cuts or restarts hikes in September. The coverage underscores how closely local investors track US inflation prints, which drive risk appetite for Taiwan's export- and tech-oriented equities.

items.title_zh: 台媒：荷莫茲海峽情勢 牽動能源與避險資產
items.title_en: Taiwan media: Strait of Hormuz tensions keep energy and safe-haven assets volatile
items.summary_zh: 台灣媒體分析指出，荷莫茲海峽對峙持續牽動能源與避險市場，原油與黃金隨美伊情勢每次轉折而波動。評論認為，即使局勢部分緩和，考量航運中斷風險猶存，油價未必大幅回落；此一能源價格變數又回饋至通膨與股市情緒，成為市場評估下半年風險時難以忽視的地緣因素。
items.summary_en: Local analysis highlights how the Strait of Hormuz standoff continues to swing energy and safe-haven markets, with crude prices and gold reacting to each turn in US–Iran developments. Commentators argue that even a partial de-escalation may not sharply lower oil, given lingering shipping-disruption risks—an energy-price overhang that feeds back into inflation and equity sentiment.

items.title_zh: 美股靜待通膨數據收黑
items.title_en: US stocks close lower ahead of inflation data
items.summary_zh: 美股週二收黑，投資人靜待7月通膨數據。標普500指數跌0.32%收7,728.20點，那斯達克指數跌0.6%收26,445.45點，道瓊工業指數跌184點、跌幅0.34%收53,791.85點。大型科技股走弱、油價走高壓抑市場情緒，資金在關鍵物價數據公布前轉趨保守觀望。
items.summary_en: Wall Street slipped on Tuesday as investors awaited July inflation prints. The S&P 500 fell 0.32% to 7,728.20, the Nasdaq Composite lost 0.6% to 26,445.45 and the Dow dropped 184 points (0.34%) to 53,791.85, with megacap tech weighing and rising oil clouding sentiment.

items.title_zh: 油價因荷莫茲海峽風險連四漲
items.title_en: Oil climbs a fourth session on Strait of Hormuz risks
items.summary_zh: 國際油價連續第四個交易日走高，西德州中級原油（WTI）逼近每桶82美元、布蘭特原油約88美元；美伊能否達成協議、重啟荷莫茲海峽通行仍不確定，令市場維持風險溢價。加以傳出葉門青年運動攻擊沙烏地Jazan煉油廠、海峽內油輪遇襲，供應疑慮升溫，支撐油價續強。
items.summary_en: Crude rose for a fourth straight session, with WTI near $82 and Brent around $88, as uncertainty over a US–Iran deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz kept a risk premium in the market. Reports of a Houthi strike on Saudi Arabia's Jazan refinery and a tanker attack in the Strait added to supply jitters.

items.title_zh: 黃金連三漲 站穩4,400美元
items.title_en: Gold rises a third session, holding above $4,400
items.summary_zh: 黃金連續第三個交易日走高，美伊緊張推升避險需求。現貨金價漲約1%至每盎司4,432.74美元，創6月5日以來新高；美國期金上漲1.7%至4,492.60美元。投資人同時為本週美國通膨報告預作布局，地緣不確定與物價前景共同支撐貴金屬買盤，金價高檔強勢。
items.summary_en: Gold advanced for a third session as US–Iran tensions stoked safe-haven demand. Spot gold climbed about 1% to $4,432.74 an ounce—its highest since June 5—while US futures rose 1.7% to $4,492.60, with investors also positioning ahead of this week's US inflation reports.

items.title_zh: 市場屏息以待美國7月CPI與PPI
items.title_en: Markets brace for July US CPI and PPI
items.summary_zh: 投資人為美國7月通膨數據預作準備，核心CPI預估月增0.1%、年增2.5%，整體生產者物價指數（PPI）估月增0.2%。這些數據將牽動市場對聯準會9月決策的預期；在能源價格居高不下、通膨黏性猶存下，政策路徑更添變數，資金因此在數據公布前保持觀望。
items.summary_en: Investors braced for July inflation data, with core CPI seen rising 0.1% and up 2.5% year-on-year, and headline PPI expected to gain 0.2%. The readings are set to shape expectations for the Federal Reserve's September decision, as sticky energy prices complicate the policy outlook.
